summary: > Torment is one of Shadow Stalker's Acolytes, first introduced during Operation: Shadow Debt. She takes the form of Mesa with Stalker's helmet, a Naberus shoulder piece, and some of Equinox's front tassels. She also uses an Eos chest plate for a codpiece, and the Eos spurs.
> As of Update 29.5 (2020-11-19), Torment can now spawn in The Steel Path missions.
sections: - "Alad V only wants profit, he is the enemy."
- "This one has caused much suffering and yet you protect him... Why?"
- "You have lost your way, Tenno, I will help you find it."
